title: Heart with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='heartGlow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e01b4c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cheekGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9fb2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- heart shape -->
  <path d='M50 88
           C50 88 12 62 12 36
           C12 20 24 12 36 12
           C44 12 50 18 50 26
           C50 18 56 12 64 12
           C76 12 88 20 88 36
           C88 62 50 88 50 88 Z'
        fill='url(#heartGlow)'
        stroke='#ff9fb2'
        stroke-width='3.5'
        stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- lighter top-left shine on heart -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='28' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffc2cf' opacity='0.6' transform='rotate(-30 31 28)'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='47' rx='5.5' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='47' rx='5.5' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='48' r='2.8' fill='#3a0a1a'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='48' r='2.8' fill='#3a0a1a'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='46' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='46' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='57' rx='6' ry='4.2' fill='url(#cheekGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='57' rx='6' ry='4.2' fill='url(#cheekGlow)'/>

  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M40 60
           Q50 72 60 60'
        fill='none'
        stroke='#3a0a1a'
        stroke-width='3'
        stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little happy tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9fb2'/>

  <!-- tiny floating hearts -->
  <g fill='#ff9fb2'>
    <path d='M18 17 C18 17 14 13 11 16 C9 18 10 21 12 23 C14 25 18 27 18 27 C18 27 22 25 24 23 C26 21 27 18 25 16 C22 13 18 17 18 17 Z' opacity='0.9'/>
    <path d='M84 16 C84 16 81 13 79 15 C78 16 78 18 80 20 C82 22 84 23 84 23 C84 23 86 22 88 20 C90 18 90 16 89 15 C87 13 84 16 84 16 Z' opacity='0.8'/>
    <path d='M21 84 C21 84 18.5 81.5 17 83 C16 84 16 86 17.5 87.5 C19 89 21 90 21 90 C21 90 23 89 24.5 87.5 C26 86 26 84 25 83 C23.5 81.5 21 84 21 84 Z' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>
</svg>
